subject.title: fix(anthropic): restrict OAuth callback host to loopback addresses and derive redirect URI

question: Should OpenClaw accept loopback-only Anthropic OAuth callback hosts and derived redirect URIs as the supported behavior for this helper, even though non-loopback OPENCLAW_OAUTH_CALLBACK_HOST values stop working during login?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but it changes an auth-provider env/default surface and resolves a public security report whose attacker model depends on trusted environment control under SECURITY.md.

options.title: Accept Loopback-Only Anthropic OAuth
options.body: Approve the fail-closed callback-host validation because arbitrary remote callback hosts are not a supported local CLI auth shape and the implementation matches the sibling OAuth pattern.

options.title: Require Live Provider Exchange Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live Anthropic token-exchange proof before accepting provider-side redirect compatibility for the allowed loopback spellings.

options.title: Pause For Anthropic OAuth Direction
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer removing or deprecating the direct Anthropic OAuth helper instead of hardening it.

recommendation.title: Accept Loopback-Only Anthropic OAuth
recommendation.body: Approve the fail-closed callback-host validation because arbitrary remote callback hosts are not a supported local CLI auth shape and the implementation matches the sibling OAuth pattern.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and strongest available owner signal for accepting the auth/security compatibility tradeoff.
